kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
استشهدتما (form X)
# اِسْتَشْهَدْتُمَا (istašhadtumā) /is.taʃ.had.tu.maː/: second-person dual past active of اِسْتَشْهَدَ (istašhada)
# اُسْتُشْهِدْتُمَا (ustušhidtumā) /us.tuʃ.hid.tu.maː/: second-person dual past passive of اِسْتَشْهَدَ (istašhada) and اُسْتُشْهِدَ (ustušhida)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
